Package io.goobi.viewer.api.rest.v1.archives

Class CardCatalogResource

java.lang.Object
io.goobi.viewer.api.rest.v1.archives.CardCatalogResource
@Path("/archives/{pi}/cardcatalog") public class CardCatalogResource extends Object
REST resource for the card catalog view of an archive: positional navigation over the cards of a digitized card catalog (drawers, zoom boundaries, dense card ranges, computed from-to register). The endpoints are independent of whether the archive is flagged as a card catalog; the flag only controls which view the archive page renders.

    • getInfo

      @GET @Produces("application/json") public CardCatalogInfo getInfo() throws PresentationException, IndexUnreachableException
      Structure and navigation configuration of the catalog. The advertised page size and full-view threshold never exceed CardCatalogManager.MAX_ENTRIES_PER_REQUEST, the hard cap of the entries endpoint; a larger page size would make paging clients skip the silently dropped tail of each page.
      Returns:
      card catalog info with drawers and navigation configuration
      Throws:
      PresentationException
      IndexUnreachableException
